prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — quick clarification so I give the best advice:
- What vehicle do you have (car/SUV/truck) and tire size (or the size printed on the sidewall)?
- Do you care more about lowest price, best selection of brands, or the highest-quality installation/service?
- Are you a Costco member?

If you just want a quick, practical answer for Pleasanton:

Where to buy tires (good options)
- Discount Tire (specialty tire retailer) — usually the best selection of brands/sizes and professional tire techs.
- Costco Tire Center (if you’re a member) — often the best price on common sizes and includes mounting/balancing and good road-hazard coverage.
- National service centers: Firestone Complete Auto Care, Pep Boys, Mavis/NTB — good if you also want other services (brakes, alignment).
- Local independent shops — can give personalized service and competitive pricing; check local Yelp/Google reviews for the best-reputed ones in Pleasanton/Dublin/Livermore.

Who does the best installation
- Specialty tire shops (Discount Tire / America’s Tire) are usually the most consistent for correct mounting, precise balancing, and fast service because tires are their core product.
- Costco is excellent value and reliable installers for most passenger tires.
- For the highest-precision work (performance tires, aftermarket wheels, TPMS, high-end balancing, and alignment), look for shops that advertise:
  - ASE-certified technicians
  - Dedicated tire balancing machines and road-force balancers
  - Free or included re-checks (torque, balance after 50–100 miles)
  - Good online reviews mentioning “no vibration,” “true balance,” and “careful install”

What to ask/confirm when you book installation
- Is mounting, balancing, and new valve stems included? (some shops charge for TPMS service)
- Do they check and/or include a wheel alignment? (recommended after new tires or if uneven wear is present)
- Do they offer a road-force balance or just standard balancing?
- What warranties or road-hazard coverage are included?
- Do they torque the lug nuts to spec and re-torque after initial miles?

How I can help next
- I can look up the current top-rated tire shops and installers near Pleasanton (names, addresses, hours, reviews) if you want — tell me you want that and I’ll pull a short list.
- Or tell me your tire size/brand preferences and I can recommend specific tires and the best places to buy them for price vs. performance.

Which would you like?
